cohort: 507 neonates admitted to the NICU of University Hospital "St. George" Plovdiv, Bulgaria, of whom 107 were placed on mechanical ventilation for >=48 hours
finding: The incidence of VAP was 31% in neonates on mechanical ventilation, and birth weight, gestational age, and duration of hospital stay were significantly associated with VAP.
gest_age: 31.08 g.w. in VAP group vs. 33.08 g.w in non-VAP group
birth_weight: 1,310 g in VAP group vs 1,690 g in non-VAP group
